name: 11th World Congress of Asian Psychiatry (WCAP 2026)
venue: Hokkaido University, Clark Memorial Student Center
description: The 11th World Congress of Asian Psychiatry is organized by the Asian Federation of Psychiatric Associations in partnership with the World Psychiatric Association at Hokkaido University under the theme Harmonization between Urbanization and Nature in Future Mental Health. The programme includes keynote lectures, symposia, workshops and oral and poster presentations.
